token.desc: Authentication token bearing the `code_channels:manage` scope. Must be a granular bot token.

channel_id.desc: ID of the code channel to archive.

summary_message_ts.desc: Timestamp of a message in the code channel to share back as a thread reply on the origin message. Requires the channel to have an `origin_link` set.

channel_not_found.desc: The specified channel_id does not correspond to a valid channel.

not_agent_channel.desc: The specified channel is not a code channel.

not_authorized.desc: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.

already_archived.desc: The channel has already been archived.

restricted_action.desc: The workspace does not allow the bot to archive channels.

summary_message_not_found.desc: The specified summary_message_ts does not correspond to a message in the code channel.

no_origin_link.desc: summary_message_ts was provided but the code channel has no origin_link set.

origin_channel_not_found.desc: The origin channel referenced by the code channel is no longer accessible.

origin_message_not_found.desc: The origin message referenced by the code channel's origin_link could not be found.
